title: A Predictive Factor Analysis of Social Biases and Task-Performance in Pretrained Masked Language Models
findings: Religion was one of several categories (along with race, gender, and profession) used to measure social bias in Masked Language Models. However, the paper's findings are aggregated across all bias types and do not provide specific results or conclusions for religious bias alone. The main findings relate to the model factors that influence overall social bias and task performance, identifying model size, tokenization, and training objectives as the most important factors.
